author: Taylor Kalin
status: ongoing; V9 native preservation passed but complete proof failed; no improved checkpoint accepted
evidence_scope: Curated summary of local lab receipts and independent mathematical checks. Native model checkpoints, raw generations, full capture caches, and private evaluation material are not distributed here. Hashes identify lab artifacts; their bytes are not included, so they are not independently reproducible from this repository alone.

runtime.limitations: Pinned lab configuration; no throughput or cross-platform equivalence guarantee. Control prompts, native template and full answer rubric must also match for a causal comparison.

promotion_policy.requires: Stored/native and complete-answer gates, comparison against immediate experimental parent and current accepted reference, and preservation of earlier accepted fixes
promotion_policy.after_qualification: Use the accepted checkpoint as the next default research parent; refresh caches and controls
promotion_policy.retention: Original, current accepted, one prior accepted rollback, active experimental files and checkpoints actual active validators read; preserve small lineage/receipts and prune obsolete weights after dependency checks
promotion_policy.disk_measurement: APFS logical size is not reclaimed bytes; measure actual free space before/after cleanup and preflight new allocations

distinctions.teaching_example: Synthetic three-token head only; does not reproduce a 27B architecture or benchmark
distinctions.numerical_helpers: Original pure NumPy infrastructure with synthetic receipts; no native file writer
distinctions.native_research: Real separately saved model candidates and ordinary native runs; results scoped as above
distinctions.evaluation: Earlier observed failures used for new fitting are training material, not unseen evaluation
